name: biodesigner
description: A biomimicry design assistant built on NASA PeTaL's BIDARA prompt. Desktop app: Next.js renderer, Express back-end, Electron shell.
//workspaces: `electron` joins this list when the shell exists — npm refuses a workspace directory with no package.json, and a stub would only make `npm run build` fail with a less useful message.

scripts.//setup: One command from a fresh clone: install and build everything.
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:renderer
scripts.//build: Order matters once the shell exists: it imports back-end/dist and serves front-end/out.
scripts.//dev: Two terminals. The renderer reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to find the back-end.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace back-end && npm run typecheck --workspace front-end
scripts.//typecheck: Delegated rather than running `tsc -p` twice from here. The two packages pin different TypeScript majors — 7 and 5 — and a root-level tsc is whichever version happened to hoist, which is neither.

author: Mau Ulisse Luz
